entries.description: Protected ledger envelope, base64, materialized by the legacy evidence transport in the devai-ledger-verification environment. Provisioned by the release maintainer from the local RC ledger export.
Protected ledger results archive, base64, materialized by the legacy evidence transport in the devai-ledger-verification environment.
Protected ledger artifacts archive, base64, materialized by the legacy evidence transport in the devai-ledger-verification environment.
Protected task policy snapshot, base64, bound to the ledger under verification in the devai-ledger-verification environment.
Protected trust store snapshot, base64: the signer allowlist with revocation that ledger verification checks signatures against. Signing keys never leave the trust store.
Protected toolchain snapshot, base64, bound to the ledger under verification in the devai-ledger-verification environment.
Protected environment snapshot, base64, bound to the ledger under verification in the devai-ledger-verification environment.
Release signer allowlist, base64, materialized only by the release workflow's ledger verification. Public identities with revocation; no private key is ever placed in a secret.

GitHub token that downloads the published evidence bundle release asset when DEVAI_LEDGER_TRANSPORT selects the bundle transport. The transport script passes it to gh as GH_TOKEN and fails with EVIDENCE_CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED when it is absent; the legacy transport does not consult it.

entries.description: The job-scoped GitHub Actions token, referenced as secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN and github.token. finalize-release needs contents:write to create the immutable Release and packages:write to publish the GitHub Packages mirror; deploy-pages needs pages:write, deployments:write, and id-token:write; promote-assets needs contents:read and actions:read to verify and retain the rehearsed assets. Each job declares exactly its own permission set. The pull-request-checks workflow references no secret and no token.

The adopter repository or protected-environment secret that the scaffolded local-RC verifier workflow (job verify-attested-rc) and the post-merge observation workflow (job observe) pass as NODE_AUTH_TOKEN to install the pinned DEVAI package from GitHub Packages. Named by law/policy/trusted-local-rc-verifier-package.json; the generated workflow fails before installation when it is absent and never falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN.
Shell variable that the project .npmrc references for GitHub Packages authentication during installation. Only the variable reference is committed; the value stays in the operator's shell.

The local gh session (keyring login or GH_TOKEN variable) that reconciles round state onto GitHub issues through gh subprocesses. DEVAI never stores the token in configuration and never falls back to a personal access token; without a session the sync reports unauthenticated and writes nothing.
